title: 2.1 Computer Peripherals
description: Peripherals, buses, expansion cards, storage and input/output devices

questions.question: According to the module, what is a computer?
options: A powerful electronic device that can perform various tasks, process data, and execute instructions
A storage device used to keep large amounts of information
A network connection that links several machines together
A type of software used to run applications
questions.correctAnswer: A powerful electronic device that can perform various tasks, process data, and execute instructions

questions.question: What is a peripheral?
options: A cable used to connect two computers directly
A program that controls the operating system
A piece of computer hardware added to a computer in order to expand its abilities
A type of internal memory found on the motherboard
questions.correctAnswer: A piece of computer hardware added to a computer in order to expand its abilities

questions.question: Which of the following best describes peripherals?
options: They are always fitted inside the system unit
They can only be connected wirelessly
They are software programs that expand the abilities of a computer
They are optional in nature, as opposed to hardware that is always required
questions.correctAnswer: They are optional in nature, as opposed to hardware that is always required

questions.question: What is a bus?
options: A subsystem that transfers data between computer components inside a computer or between computers
A slot used to attach a monitor to the power supply
A type of removable storage device
A program that manages input and output devices
questions.correctAnswer: A subsystem that transfers data between computer components inside a computer or between computers

questions.question: What are the two types of buses in a computer system?
options: Storage buses and power buses
Internal buses and external buses
Video buses and sound buses
Serial buses and wireless buses
questions.correctAnswer: Internal buses and external buses

questions.question: PCI is common in modern PCs. Which technology is succeeding this kind of bus?
options: PS/2
AGP
PCI Express
FireWire
questions.correctAnswer: PCI Express

questions.question: True or False: PCI Express was introduced by Intel in 2004.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: What typical PCI cards are used in PCs?
options: Network cards, sound cards, modems, extra ports, TV tuner cards and disk controllers
Printers, scanners and webcams
Video cards, power supplies and speakers
Keyboards, mice and touch screens
questions.correctAnswer: Network cards, sound cards, modems, extra ports, TV tuner cards and disk controllers

questions.question: Why have video cards outgrown the capabilities of PCI?
options: Because PCI cards can no longer be bought
Because of their higher bandwidth requirements
Because video cards need no expansion slot
Because PCI slots are too large to fit inside a PC
questions.correctAnswer: Because of their higher bandwidth requirements

questions.question: What was PCI Express designed to replace?
options: The hard drive and the floppy drive
The USB and FireWire connections
The keyboard and the mouse ports
The general-purpose PCI expansion bus and the AGP graphics card interface
questions.correctAnswer: The general-purpose PCI expansion bus and the AGP graphics card interface

questions.question: Which of the following describes PCI Express?
options: It is a wireless standard for connecting peripherals
It is a port used only for external storage devices
It is a parallel bus that shares the same set of wires
It is a point-to-point connection of serial links called lanes
questions.correctAnswer: It is a point-to-point connection of serial links called lanes

questions.question: Why do PCI Express cards make better video cards than PCI cards?
options: They are cheaper to produce
They have faster bandwidth
They use less power
They fit into more slots
questions.correctAnswer: They have faster bandwidth

questions.question: What is an AGP (Accelerated Graphics Port)?
options: A wireless connection used to link two monitors
A serial connection used for high-speed data transfer between computers
A high-speed point-to-point channel for attaching a graphics card to the motherboard, primarily to assist in the acceleration of 3D computer graphics
A general-purpose bus used to connect printers
questions.correctAnswer: A high-speed point-to-point channel for attaching a graphics card to the motherboard, primarily to assist in the acceleration of 3D computer graphics

questions.question: Which technology has largely replaced AGP over the past years?
options: PCI Express
USB
PS/2
FireWire
questions.correctAnswer: PCI Express

questions.question: What is the function of a video card?
options: To provide audio signals to speakers
To store data permanently on a hard disk
To generate and output images to a display
To connect a computer to a network
questions.correctAnswer: To generate and output images to a display

questions.question: What is the GPU (graphics processing unit) on a video card?
options: A connector used for a standard monitor cable
A basic program that governs the card's operations
A memory chip used to store images temporarily
A dedicated microprocessor optimized for 3D graphics rendering
questions.correctAnswer: A dedicated microprocessor optimized for 3D graphics rendering

questions.question: True or False: If a video card is integrated in the motherboard, it may use the computer's RAM memory.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: According to the module, what range do most video RAM memories fall into?
options: From 512KB to 1MB
From 8MB to 16MB
From 128MB to 2GB
From 1GB to 64GB
questions.correctAnswer: From 128MB to 2GB

questions.question: What is the function of a RAMDAC on a video card?
options: Storing images before they are displayed
Cooling the graphics processing unit
Turning the digital signals produced by the processor into an analog signal understood by the display
Connecting multiple monitors wirelessly
questions.correctAnswer: Turning the digital signals produced by the processor into an analog signal understood by the display

questions.question: What is a sound card?
options: A card that generates and outputs images to a display
An expansion card that facilitates the input and output of audio signals under control of computer programs
A card that provides extra USB ports
A card that allows computers to communicate over a network
questions.correctAnswer: An expansion card that facilitates the input and output of audio signals under control of computer programs

questions.question: What does a network card allow computers to do?
options: Produce sound for multimedia applications
Provide power to low-consumption devices
Communicate over a computer network, either by using cables or wirelessly
Display images on multiple monitors
questions.correctAnswer: Communicate over a computer network, either by using cables or wirelessly

questions.question: True or False: Every Ethernet network card has a unique 48-bit serial number called a MAC address, which is stored in ROM on the card.
options: False
True
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: What is USB (Universal Serial Bus)?
options: An internal bus used to connect the processor and memory
A wireless standard for connecting keyboards
A serial bus standard used to interface devices
A parallel bus standard used to connect monitors
questions.correctAnswer: A serial bus standard used to interface devices

questions.question: Which feature of USB improves plug-and-play capabilities?
options: Only working while the computer is turned off
Requiring an external power supply for every device
Allowing devices to be connected and disconnected without rebooting the computer
Needing a separate driver for each manufacturer
questions.correctAnswer: Allowing devices to be connected and disconnected without rebooting the computer

questions.question: What is the dominating bus for connecting external devices to a computer?
options: PCI
USB
AGP
PS/2
questions.correctAnswer: USB

questions.question: What is FireWire (IEEE 1394), also known as i.LINK for Sony?
options: A wireless standard for connecting mice
An internal bus for connecting memory chips
A serial bus interface standard for high-speed communications and isochronous real-time data transfer
A parallel port used only for printers
questions.correctAnswer: A serial bus interface standard for high-speed communications and isochronous real-time data transfer

questions.question: Which connection is used for connecting some keyboards and mice to a PC compatible computer system?
options: The S-Video connector
The PS/2 connector
The component video connector
The AGP slot
questions.correctAnswer: The PS/2 connector

questions.question: True or False: A PS/2 mouse connected to a PS/2 keyboard port may not be recognized by the computer.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: Which of the following describes USB flash drives?
options: Read-only and designed for permanent storage
Small, fast, removable, rewritable, and long-lasting
Usable only with an external power supply
Large, slow and built into the motherboard
questions.correctAnswer: Small, fast, removable, rewritable, and long-lasting

questions.question: Why is a flash drive usually more durable and smaller than a hard drive?
options: Because it uses vacuum tubes instead of chips
Because it needs no memory at all
Because it has no mechanically driven parts
Because it is always connected externally
questions.correctAnswer: Because it has no mechanically driven parts

questions.question: What is a popular use of external hard drives?
options: Backups, shared drives among many computers, and expanding hard drive space
Providing audio signals for multimedia applications
Adding a wireless connection to the internet
Generating and outputting images to a display
questions.correctAnswer: Backups, shared drives among many computers, and expanding hard drive space

questions.question: Which of the following are the most common input devices?
options: Projectors and screens
Speakers and headphones
Mice and keyboards
Monitors and printers
questions.correctAnswer: Mice and keyboards

questions.question: Which new popular pointing device may eventually replace the mouse?
options: Scanner
Trackball
Webcam
Touch screen
questions.correctAnswer: Touch screen

questions.question: What is the absolute most common external output device?
options: A printer
A speaker
A projector
A monitor
questions.correctAnswer: A monitor
